Hold a Wrench in your main hand and a material in your offhand. Right-click to replace the material.
You can also hold the material in your main hand and the Wrench in your offhand.
Sneak bypasses this addon's replacement. Create's normal Wrench action takes over.
Hold [%s], your Connected Action key, while right-clicking with Wrench and material to apply to connected empty Copycats.
With material already applied, the same action replaces matching materials in the group.
Keep holding the Connected Action key, use only a Wrench and leave the other hand empty to remove matching materials.
Groups follow shared faces and the same Copycat type. The server limit, available stock and build permissions restrict each action.
A denied position blocks propagation through that route. The preview is an estimate; protected positions stay unchanged.
For example, with a server limit of 2, only two positions change, including the clicked Copycat.
